route.instructions: Which candidate_routes route directly supplies retained descriptor backing before the first queue address publication, while preserving the unmarked fallback? Do not choose implementation details or grant permissions.

criteria.allocate_before_queue_publication: Provider owns the allocation before queue registers can expose it.
criteria.copy_during_rx_event_init: Late copy establishes ownership before the original pointer is exposed.
criteria.keep_managed_memory: Managed address alone establishes retained ownership.

lifetime_gap.instructions: Does queue_allocation plus provider_lifetime leave the RX-event descriptor allocation outside the provider's retained coherent-allocation records?

criteria.true: RX-event backing is managed separately and has no retained provider record.
criteria.false: The provider already records and retains RX-event backing.

later_tx_overlap.instructions: If provider-owned RX-event backing is allocated before TX buffers, must TX validation also check those later TX allocations against the retained RX-event span to preserve disjoint backing?

criteria.true: The existing BAR/plan/mailbox/earlier-TX comparisons omit this newly retained span.
criteria.false: Those existing comparisons necessarily cover the new RX-event span.

full_completion.instructions: Would adding retained RX-event descriptor backing alone establish the full NPU implementation, including authenticated API22/DESC10, hot lifecycle and physical drain authority?

criteria.supported: All named requirements follow from allocation ownership alone.
criteria.not_established: Allocation ownership is one prerequisite and the other named requirements still need implementation/evidence.
criteria.unknown: The supplied evidence is insufficient even to identify the scope.
